body:
Earlier this year I had gotten into kratom. I loved it. A legal opioid - what could be better? ...A legal opioid with snuff.
I took kratom on a daily basis. One day I was bored, messing around on my computer when I came across the wikipedia article for tobacco. I remembered my friend telling me about nasal snuff. I decided to look up the article. I found it intriguing, and quickly looked for a shop to purchase it nearby. THIS WAS NO EASY TASK. Being a resident of the US, it was VERY hard to find a retailer for snuff. I spent around 2 hours searching the internet for a snuff retailer. Finally, I found someone. It was about a 30 min drive away, but I said fuck it. So I went for it, I drove there and purchased 3 tins: Raspberry, Spearmint, and Apricot. They were extremely cheap. I cracked open the apricot tin on the street and knocked a generous bump on my hand. I gently sniffed it into my right, then left nostrils. It burned like hell, made my eyes water, and made me sneeze. But soon after, I noticed the subtle, but present synergy with kratom. I loved it. Now whenever I'm high on kratom I sniff a little bit of my snuff.
Nasal snuff is very enjoyable and I'm surprised its not more popular in the states.
